17. Proxy vs Reverse Proxy

A forward proxy acts on behalf of clients; a reverse proxy fronts servers and routes incoming
requests.
Forward proxy එක clients JවනුJවන් request යවනවා. Reverse proxy එක servers ඉදිරිJයන් ඉඳලා

Reverse proxy එක servers ඉදිරිJයන් ඉඳලා incoming · requests route කරනවා.
Expected result: In a valid server configuration, matching requests forward to the backend.

Q: Why use a reverse proxy?
A: Central routing, TLS termination and load balancing are common reasons.
